gen-dafont-visitor-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Visitor brings the nostalgic digital punch; the sans does the steady talking.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-amulya: Tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Woodgod its vintage swagger. Amulya follows with generous curve gaps, and the jump in lowercase height between the two is the real draw.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-plein: Loud, vintage and swaggering, with lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Woodgod handles the commanding statement, while Plein quietly does the reliable work of keeping each round letter clear to enter.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads friendly and contemporary, with wide gaps at the curve ends and a constant-width trace like a laser-etched line. Woodgod does vintage command; the sans does approachable, everyday clarity.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-almendra: Woodgod announces itself with a wide channel into every bowl and lowercase that nearly meets the capitals. Almendra then settles into dignified, bookish paragraphs, its deep-bellied lowercase carrying the text along without fuss.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-bree-serif: Literary and refined, with outsized lowercase proportions, the text side of this pair feels quietly settled. Bree Serif handles the patient reading, while Woodgod does the commanding, vintage announcing.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-port-lligat-slab: Commanding from the first glance, Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl and lifts its lowercase toward the capitals. Port Lligat Slab follows with porthole-wide counters and a literary, traditional hum that carries paragraphs gently.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-quando: Sparse letter spacing and a big, tall middle zone give the text a bookish, traditional drawl. Quando sits against the commanding, vintage shout of Woodgod, and that gap between loud and unhurried is the strength.
gen-dafont-woodgod-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves stopping short of closing, like cable bent into shapes. And Woodgod, with its vintage command, hands the text over to that sans-serif so paragraphs run smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-plus-jakarta-sans: Big personality, then precision: Woodgod brings tall vintage lowercase while Plus Jakarta Sans draws monoline curves kept well apart. Shrink the heading and that commanding presence fades quickly beside the body.
